label.purpose: Small uppercase state and metadata labels.

mono.purpose: Exact times, amounts, and rule strings.

shadows.name: ambient-interval
shadows.purpose: Separate the live interval bar from the graphite canvas.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Small hover and selected-state changes on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all transitions and scroll behavior.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Full-width entry action for starting a replay or placing the selected position.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:9px; width:100%; height:48px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid var(--cyan); border-radius:7px; background:var(--cyan); color:var(--canvas-deep); font:700 12px Arial, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--silver-bright); border-color:var(--silver-bright); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Surface panel
components.description: Flat graphite working surface with a single structural rule.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:14px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); } .ds-panel h3 { margin:0; color:var(--paper); font:600 17px/1.2 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin:6px 0 0; color:var(--muted); font:400 12px/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Stake input
components.description: Tabular demo-credit amount field in the entry rail.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; height:48px; padding:0 12px 0 14px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:7px; background:var(--canvas); } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color:var(--cyan); } .ds-input-wrap input { width:100%; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:var(--paper); font:500 20px/1.4 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-input-wrap span { color:var(--muted); font:400 11px Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Evidence chip
components.description: Compact label for synthetic evidence and protocol state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 7px; border:1px solid rgba(113,216,207,.35); border-radius:4px; color:var(--cyan); font:700 9px/1.3 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Metal choice
components.description: Rectangular GOLD / SILVER control that makes the market decision explicit.
components.css: .ds-metal-choice { width:100%; min-height:83px; padding:13px 14px; display:grid; gap:3px; border:1px solid var(--silver); border-radius:7px; background:#1b2325; color:var(--paper); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-metal-choice span { font:700 12px/1.3 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-metal-choice i { display:inline-block; width:8px; height:8px; margin-right:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--silver); } .ds-metal-choice strong { font:500 15px/1.3 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-metal-choice small { color:var(--quiet); font:400 10px/1.3 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-metal-choice:hover { background:var(--surface-raised); } .ds-metal-choice:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
MetalSwap is styled as a quiet instrument panel for making one time-bounded decision. Graphite surfaces keep the screen analytical and low-noise; the two metals get their own material voice so the choice can be read before it is clicked. The density is deliberate: a live working surface first, supporting evidence below.

The visual language is flat, bordered, and precise. Cyan belongs to evidence, protocol, and focus states; it is not a general-purpose decoration. The screen avoids gradients, glass, crypto-neon spectacle, fabricated market activity, and ornamental imagery. Synthetic data is always named where it appears.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument-like graphite canvas with thin structural rules.
Warm brass for gold, cool silver for silver, cyan for evidence and finality.
Tabular numbers and monospace protocol labels for quick scanning.
One dominant entry bench, with history and settlement detail kept subordinate.

rules.name: The Rare Cyan Rule
rules.body: Cyan signals a protocol or interaction state; it should not become a general decorative accent.

rules.name: The Instrument Numbers Rule
rules.body: Display amounts and timestamps with tabular numerals; never make exact market state look ornamental.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be understood through tonal contrast and a rule, do not add elevation.

dos: Do make GOLD and SILVER the clearest competing controls on the first working surface.
Do use cyan for evidence, finality, focus, and verified protocol steps.
Do keep timestamps, pool amounts, and rule versions tabular and exact-looking.
Do label synthetic or illustrative values at the point of use.
Do preserve the mobile order: entry decision first, context second, settlement proof below.
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, default crypto neon, or decorative coin imagery.
Don't imply live liquidity, volume, history, addresses, or finality without a readback.
Don't turn every section into a repeated rounded card; use the terminal's structural hierarchy.
Don't let chart movement or a provisional leader masquerade as the settlement result.
